title: Greedy & Scanning Patterns
description: Recognise when local-optimum decisions yield the global optimum and when they don't. Build the muscle for greedy interval problems, scheduling, and scanning-with-state patterns that show up across every Python interview loop.
outcomes: You'll recognise when a greedy strategy provably works, choose between sorting-first vs scanning-once, compose greedy with binary-search bounds, and handle classic interval-merging cases without overengineering toward DP.
